rationale: The assistant immediately identified the likely moisture/residue cause matching the hidden truth, gave safe instructions (isolate electrically, dry, reseat caps, no poking into burner holes, no dismantling) and included the gas-smell emergency procedure and a Gas Safe escalation path if clicking persists when dry. The follow-up correctly used only what the customer reported ('wiped the grease off', 'wonky cap', 'unplugged', 'stopped clicking') and stayed appropriately hedged with 'likely triggers'. It skipped asking the diagnostic questions outright in favour of actionable steps, which worked here but is a minor trade-off; no parts were recommended and the case was resolved efficiently in two turns.
